analyzed_vuln.description: Heap buffer overflow in sp_384_from_mp: it copies sizeof(sp_digit) * a->used bytes from mp_int->dp into destination r without bounding by the destination capacity (size argument). In the crashing path, sp_ecc_mulmod_384 allocates k for exactly 6 sp_digit elements (48 bytes) and calls sp_384_from_mp(k, 6, km); if km->used > 6, XMEMCPY writes past k (ASan shows 56-byte write into 48-byte allocation).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Via cryptofuzz ECC_Point_Mul, wc_ecc_mulmod_ex routes to sp_ecc_mulmod_384 when modulus is 384 bits. Input controls scalar k (km). wc_ecc_mulmod_ex checks mp_count_bits(k) <= mp_count_bits(modulus)+1, which still allows km->used to exceed 6 limbs in this build/representation. Then sp_ecc_mulmod_384 allocates fixed 6-limb buffer and passes km to sp_384_from_mp, which memcpy's a->used limbs unchecked, causing OOB write when km has more than 6 limbs.
